config.tacz.client.render.gun_hurt_bob_m: First-person vanilla hurt tilt multiplier with a gun in the main hand. 0 disables it, 1 preserves vanilla side-hit strength; default 0.1. Front/back hits use half this multiplier, with smooth transitions for diagonal hits. Multiplies vanilla Damage Tilt. Gunshot-specific hurt effects still use gun data settings.
config.tacz.client.render.enable_translu: Should enable translucent while rendering block entity like gunsmith table or statue. Enable this option will result in ADDITIONAL PERFORMANCE OVERHEAD.
config.tacz.client.render.display_gun_vb: Use experimental VBO rendering for guns in display cases and pegboards.
config.tacz.client.render.static_item_gu: Use experimental VBO rendering for guns held in third person, dropped on the ground, or shown in item frames outside GUI screens.
config.tacz.client.resource.enable_lazy_: Build heavy client assets such as models and animation state machines on demand. Inventory items are pre-warmed in the background when possible.
config.tacz.client.sound.hit_sound_concu: Max active hit feedback sounds for the same entity and sound id. 0 disables this limit.
config.tacz.client.sound.default_sound_c: Max active normal gun sounds for the same entity and sound id. 0 disables this limit.
config.tacz.client.sound.high_frequency_: Max active high-frequency gun sounds, such as shooting and animation keyframe sounds, for the same entity and sound id. 0 disables this limit.
config.tacz.client.sound.first_person_an: Use a non-relative entity-tracking world sound source for first-person animation keyframe sounds. This can improve compatibility with physical sound mods, but may introduce slight stereo drift while moving.
config.tacz.client.zoom.screen_distance_: Coeficiente de distância de tela para zoom, usando o padrão MDV, o padrão é MDV133
config.tacz.client.zoom.zoom_sensitivity: A sensibilidade do zoom é multiplicada por este fator

config.tacz.common.ammo.explosive_ammo_k: Munição com propriedades explosivas podem ter um efeito de repulsão
config.tacz.common.ammo.explosive_ammo_v: A distância na qual o efeito de explosão pode ser visto
config.tacz.common.ammo.pass_through_blo: Blocks that bullets can pass through. Accepts block IDs and tags prefixed with #, such as minecraft:glass or #forge:glass.
config.tacz.common.ammo.destroy_glass.de: Allow bullets to destroy blocks in the Destroy Blocks list without drops. The list is not limited to glass.
config.tacz.common.ammo.destroy_blocks.d:
Blocks that bullets can destroy when Destroy Glass is enabled, subject to the hardness threshold.
 Accepts block IDs and tags prefixed with #.
config.tacz.common.ammo.destroy_block_ha:
Maximum hardness for direct bullet destruction, including blocks in Destroy Blocks.
 Blocks above this value or with negative hardness (unbreakable) are protected.
config.tacz.common.ammo.ignore_team_frie: Bullets pass through members of the shooter's scoreboard team without consuming pierce count when friendly fire is disabled. Explosion area damage is unchanged.
config.tacz.common.ammo.enable_bullet_da: Bullets pass through listed entities without consuming pierce count or igniting them. Ammo explosions cause no damage or knockback to them. Disabled by default; uses the server's configuration.
config.tacz.common.ammo.bullet_damage_ig: Entity type IDs protected when the ignore list is enabled. Defaults to vanilla paintings, item frames and glow item frames.
config.tacz.common.ammo.global_speed_mod: Modificador Global de Velocidade de Munição
Velocidade de munição é multiplicada por este valor
config.tacz.common.other.default_pack_de:
Enable to preserve local default pack edits. When disabled, changes to the mod version or bundled resources trigger replacement at startup.
To regenerate, disable this option, delete tacz/tacz_default_gun, then restart.
config.tacz.common.other.target_sound_di: A mais distante distância de som do alvo, incluindo tipos de carrinho de minas
